description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Periodic' that provides financial calculation functions such as IRR, MIRR, and NPV, used for cash flow analysis.

classes.name: Periodic
classes.description: Provides financial functions such as IRR, MIRR, and NPV for cash flow analysis.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Calculates the internal rate of return (IRR) for a series of cash flows.

methods.name: modifiedRate
methods.description: Calculates the modified internal rate of return (MIRR) considering finance and reinvestment rates.

methods.name: presentValue
methods.description: Computes the net present value (NPV) of a series of cash flows given a discount rate.
